name: Microsoft Teams
summary: Microsoft's chat, meetings and calling for work.

flows.title: Create a team
steps: On the left side of the app, select Chat, or Teams if using the separate view.
Select New items above the list of chats and channels, then New team.
Name the team and add an optional description.
Choose Private to limit it to a certain group of people, or Public for anyone in the org.
Name the first channel, then select Create.

flows.title: Attach a file to a chat message
steps: In the chat or channel, select Actions and apps, then Attach file.
Select a recently opened file, or choose Attach cloud files or Upload from this device.

flows.title: Pin a chat message
steps: In the chat, hover over the message to pin.
In the menu above the message, select More options.
Choose Pin for everyone. The message appears at the top of the chat.
